description:
Compile-time source generator that auto-registers ASP.NET Core Minimal API
      endpoints from attribute-decorated classes. Zero reflection, Native AOT safe.
      Supports .NET 8, 9, and 10.
releaseNotes:
1.1.0
- Fixed: [EndpointMeta]/[RouteGroup]/[AuthorizeEndpoint] strings containing quotes, backslashes or newlines produced uncompilable code.
- Fixed: [RouteGroup] prefixes containing route parameters ("/t/{tenantId}") or dots ("/v1.0"), or prefixes like "/a-b" and "/a_b", produced uncompilable code.
- Fixed: endpoint classes nested inside other classes produced uncompilable code.
- Fixed: namespace-qualified ([MinimalApiGen.Get]) and aliased attributes were silently ignored.
- Fixed: attributes with the same short name from other namespaces/libraries were treated as MinimalApiGen attributes.
- Fixed: only the first of several [AuthorizeEndpoint] attributes was applied; all policies are now required.
- Fixed: false MAG001 errors for [FromRoute(Name = "...")] parameters, [AsParameters] types, default values ({page=1}) and escaped braces.
- Fixed: [ExcludeFromGeneration] on a non-static method no longer reports MAG002.
- New diagnostics: MAG005 (duplicate route), MAG006 (unbound route-group parameter), MAG007 (multiple verb attributes), MAG008 (handler not referenceable from generated code), MAG009 (multiple [ApiVersion]).
- Generator now uses ForAttributeWithMetadataName with cacheable models for faster IDE performance.
- Attribute XML documentation is now included in the package.

1.0.0
- Initial release.
- Attributes: RouteGroup (route prefix + OpenAPI Tag), Get/Post/Put/Patch/Delete, AuthorizeEndpoint (method- or class-level, with method-level taking precedence and AllowAnonymousEndpoint able to opt a method out of a class-level policy), AllowAnonymousEndpoint, ApiVersion, EndpointMeta (Summary + Description), ExcludeFromGeneration.
- Diagnostics: MAG001 (missing route param), MAG002 (method must be static), MAG003 (missing [RouteGroup]), MAG004 (conflicting auth attributes on the same method).
- Supports .NET 8.0, 9.0 and 10.0 (and any netstandard2.0-compatible target) — zero reflection, Native AOT safe.
